title: 第十五章    两败俱伤
content_zh:
四周突然变得异常安静，人与兽对峙着，时间一分一秒的流逝，谁都没有动手的趋势。天空乌云逐渐增多，那种阴沉的乌云仿佛从天而降，压的人喘不过气来。

    一道闪电突然划破天空，轰隆隆！雷声骤然响起，刹那间打破了眼前的宁静。随着雷声响起，金毛狮的攻击也随之开始，吼！一个能量球直轰范森一伙人。“倾尽全力动手，攻击这金毛狮，我就不信了，凭我们这么多人还对付不了这智力低下的畜生！”范森回头对着人群说道。顿时上百道能量光束朝着只轰而来的能量球而去，嘭！两道能量顿时化作满天光屑，散落而下，随之而下的还有倾到下来的雨滴。

    “杀，宰了这畜生！”上百人冲了上去，阴沉的天空，无数条闪电划破天空，在闪电的映衬下，众人手持的刀剑变得精光闪闪。吼！金毛狮双目紧盯着围冲上来的人流，浑身凝成一个防护光罩。铛！范森一刀砍在了金毛狮身上。“居然毫发无损！”这是范森被击落前的反应，倒飞而出的范森在泥泞的地上划出了深深的的痕迹。噗！一口鲜血从嘴中喷出，范森艰难的爬了起来，面目狰狞的盯着金毛狮。此刻的范森已没有了追杀琼霄那时的那种盛气凌人的气势，相反他的周身散发的混乱的星力，显然是在金毛狮的反击下受了很重的伤，那毕竟是相当于玄星境中期高手的攻击，仅仅只是**境巅峰的范森显然不太可能承受那种程度的攻击，随着范森吐出的鲜血瞬间也被雨水冲刷干净。感受着自己体内的情况，范森发现他已经有了突破的征兆。

    啊！一个壮汉突然被金毛狮一脚踩到了地底下，地面上渗出的血液与地上汇集而成的雨水混合在一起，顿时雨水变得更加猩红，然而被踩在在地上的壮汉生死不知。咻！金毛狮一尾卷住一人，甩了出去，砰！砰！砰！被甩飞的人沿途撞断了数十棵大树。最后重重的撞在了一块巨石上。破碎的内脏从他的口中不停喷出了，生机迅速消逝，生死已定。

    看着死去的几个同伴，众人变得越加的疯狂，不停地冲上去，誓要扯下金毛狮的皮肉一般，紧盯着不停的冲上来的人流，金毛狮也越发的暴怒，一道道凌厉的攻击不停的发出，抵御着众人的进攻。上空的闪电肆虐，划破那仿佛已是破碎的天空；下方的能量弥漫，不停着冲击着仿佛就要掉落的叶子，人与兽宛如在末日般的世界里进行着战斗。

    狂风大作，电闪雷鸣，地上的雨水也越发的大，人与兽战斗之处不停的的有人掉落，也不停的有人跳起……

    “大家坚持住，我快要突破了，只要我进入玄星境，这头畜生的死期就到了！”雨中的范森急切的吼道。

    听到范森的声音，众人的攻击也开始拼命起来，受伤的没受伤的，都朝着金毛狮进攻着，特别是那十几位**境的高手，他们作为主要的进攻力量，因此进攻更加的凌厉，他们只要坚持到范森突破，他们的胜算就会增加。“大伙，为了给死去的弟兄们报仇，我们一定要坚持到宗主突破，”一个浑身泥泞的人说道，这人就是二宗主严雀。原本身穿白色衣服的他，此刻衣服上的颜色早已分辨不出来。“奔雷掌！”严雀一掌朝着金毛狮劈了过去，吼！一声暴虐的声音夹杂着一丝凄厉的声音响起，经受了了上百人长时间的攻击，金毛狮的力量有些减弱，周身的能量罩被严雀击破，随后又被严雀一掌劈在了身上！作为回击，金毛狮的尾巴狠狠的抽在了严雀的身体上，碰！严雀被击落下地，砸出了一个深坑。“这头畜生已经筋疲力尽了，大家尽力攻击，不能让它有丝毫的喘息的机会！”严雀爬出深坑虚弱的说道。

    听到严雀的话语，加之看到严雀的攻击的确对金毛狮造成了伤害，众人也开始振奋起来，只要金毛狮受伤了，就有机会击败金毛狮，获得金毛狮的灵核，这是一个好东西。

    “列地刺！”

    “穿风刺！”

    “旋风踢！”
content_en:
The surroundings suddenly became extremely quiet. Man and beast were confronting each other. Time passed by, and no one had any intention of taking action. The dark clouds in the sky are gradually increasing, and the gloomy dark clouds seem to be falling from the sky, making people breathless.

    A bolt of lightning suddenly pierced the sky, boom! Thunder suddenly sounded, breaking the tranquility in an instant. As the thunder sounded, the golden lion's attack also began, roar! An energy ball hit Fan Sen and his group. "I will use all my strength to attack this golden lion. I don't believe it. With so many of us, we can't deal with this beast with low intelligence!" Fan Sen turned back to the crowd and said. Suddenly hundreds of energy beams headed towards the incoming energy ball, bang! The two rays of energy suddenly turned into light fragments all over the sky, scattering down, followed by raindrops.

    "Kill, kill this beast!" Hundreds of people rushed forward. In the gloomy sky, countless lightning bolts pierced the sky. Against the background of the lightning, the swords held by everyone became gleaming. roar! The golden retriever lion stared closely at the crowd of people rushing up, and his whole body formed a protective light shield. clang! Fan Sen slashed the golden lion with a knife. "Unscathed!" This was Fan Sen's reaction before he was shot down. Fan Sen flew upside down and left deep marks on the muddy ground. puff! A mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth. Fan Sen climbed up with difficulty and stared at the golden lion with a ferocious face. At this moment, Fan Sen no longer had the arrogant momentum he had when he was chasing Qiong Xiao. On the contrary, he was exuding chaotic star power. He was obviously seriously injured by the golden lion's counterattack. After all, it was an attack equivalent to that of a master in the middle stage of the Xuanxing Realm. Fan Sen, who was only at the peak of the Xuanxing Realm, was obviously unlikely to withstand that level of attack. The blood that Fan Sen spat out was instantly washed away by the rain. Feeling the situation inside his body, Fan Sen found that he had signs of a breakthrough.

    ah! A strong man was suddenly stepped on by a golden lion. The blood seeping out of the ground mixed with the rainwater collected on the ground. The rainwater suddenly became scarleter. However, the life or death of the strong man who was stepped on was unknown. call out! The golden lion caught a person with its tail and threw him out, bang! Bang! Bang! The person who was thrown away broke dozens of trees along the way. Finally, he hit a boulder hard. Broken internal organs kept spurting out from his mouth, the vitality quickly disappeared, and life and death were determined.

    Seeing the dead companions, everyone became more and more crazy. They kept rushing forward, vowing to tear off the golden retriever lion's skin and flesh. Staring at the continuous flow of people rushing up, the golden retriever lion became more and more furious, and kept sending out sharp attacks one after another, resisting everyone's attacks. Lightning raged in the sky, piercing the sky that seemed to be broken; the energy below filled the air, constantly impacting the leaves that seemed to be about to fall, and humans and animals seemed to be fighting in a doomsday world.

    The wind is strong, lightning and thunder are blowing, and the rain on the ground is getting heavier and heavier. Where humans and beasts are fighting, people keep falling, and people keep jumping up...

    "Everyone, hold on, I'm about to break through. As long as I enter the Xuanxing Realm, this beast will die!" Fan Sen shouted eagerly in the rain.

    Hearing Fan Sen's voice, everyone began to attack with all their strength. The injured and not injured all attacked the Golden Retriever Lion, especially the dozen or so elite level masters. As the main offensive force, they attacked more fiercely. As long as they persisted until Fan Sen broke through, their chances of winning would increase. "Everyone, in order to avenge the dead brothers, we must persist until the sect leader breaks through," said a man covered in mud, this person is the second sect leader Yan Que. He was originally wearing white clothes, but now the colors on his clothes could no longer be distinguished. "Thunder Palm!" Yan Que struck the golden-haired lion with his palm, roaring! A violent voice mixed with a shrill voice rang out. After being attacked by hundreds of people for a long time, the golden lion's strength was somewhat weakened. The energy shield around it was broken by Yan Que, and then Yan Que struck him with a palm! In retaliation, the golden lion's tail whipped Yan Que's body hard, touch! Yan Que was shot to the ground, creating a deep pit. "This beast is exhausted. Let's attack as hard as we can without giving it a chance to breathe!" Yan Que said weakly as he crawled out of the pit.

    Hearing Yan Que's words and seeing that Yan Que's attack had indeed caused damage to the golden retriever lion, everyone began to cheer up. As long as the golden retriever lion was injured, there would be a chance to defeat the golden retriever lion and obtain the golden retriever lion's spiritual core. This was a good thing.

    "Lie Dithorn!"

    "Piercing the Wind!"

    "Tornado Kick!"
